title: Verify: game vitest config alias unit tests
summary: Test the @game alias and include glob in the game vitest config
description: Add a unit test reading the config object.
acceptance_criteria: Given the config, when imported, then @game alias ends with src
Given the config, then include contains tests/**/*.test.ts
technical_constraints: Import ../vitest.config default export; no filesystem beyond that

steps.action: Create the file importing config from ../vitest.config and assert config.resolve.alias['@game'] ends with '/src' and config.test.include contains 'tests/**/*.test.ts'
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/preloadConfig.test.ts
